high_level_description: The image is a digital post from an Instagram account named "astralmanifestation." The post features a quote by Alan Watts that reads: "'This is the real secret of life -- to be completely engaged with what you are doing ... And instead of calling it work, realize it is play.' -Alan Watts." Below the quote, there is an illustration of a wizard standing beside a birdbath. The wizard has a long white beard, wears a pointed hat adorned with stars and a crescent moon, and is dressed in a blue robe with gold star patterns.
